generated_output.summary: When integrating vision models (such as deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp) through EchoBird's Codex integration, EchoBird generates the ~/.codex/models.json configuration file with input_modalities hardcoded to ["text"]. Consequently, Codex treats the model as a text-only model and blocks image uploads with the error "This model does not support image inputs".
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: EchoBird uses compiled-in capability templates and model catalog generation routines (such as those in src-tauri/src/services/codex_catalog.rs) which declare fixed input modalities like ["text"] or lack a dynamic check for vision capability on third-party responses passthrough endpoints.

step_by_step_plan.description: Modify DEEPSEEK_TEMPLATE and associated vendor templates within src-tauri/src/services/codex_catalog.rs to support ["text", "image"] input modalities for multimodal models.

step_by_step_plan.description: Add a unit test in src-tauri/src/services/tool_config_manager.rs or codex_catalog.rs verifying that vision-capable models correctly serialize input_modalities including both text and image.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: A configuration field (input_modalities) that informs client applications like Codex whether a model accepts only text or also images and other media.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Client applications inspect these metadata declarations to enable or disable UI buttons such as image uploaders before sending requests.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: EchoBird hardcodes input_modalities to ["text"] in its generated catalog/template, causing Codex to falsely assume the model is text-only.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Static JSON templates embedded into the Rust binary at compile time using macros like include_str! to configure third-party tool integrations.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: They provide reproducible, fast configurations for external AI coding assistants without needing dynamic file lookups at runtime.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The DeepSeek template embedded in the codebase dictates the static input modalities written into ~/.codex/models.json on every startup.

common_pitfalls: Do not manually edit ~/.codex/models.json outside of EchoBird as changes will be overwritten on the next application launch.
Do not assume all models from a provider support vision; ensure any template updates or configuration flags correctly distinguish text-only models from vision-capable models.
